card.name: Spaces and linking words before pediatric numbers
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word (than, and, or) just before a number or term in pediatric or renal dosing text, such as an eGFR cutoff for adult versus pediatric patients, or infant dose per kg.

modes.label: Before renal cutoff numbers
modes.description: The space or word 'than' just before a repeated eGFR threshold number for adult or pediatric patients.
modes.example: (eGFR less than 30 mL/min for adult patients or less than<< >>30 mL/min/1.7

modes.label: Before infant dose amounts
modes.description: The space before a per-kg dose or fluid amount in pediatric or neonatal instructions.
modes.example: The recommended pediatric dose is<< >>0.5 g/kg arginine hydro

modes.label: Within infant exposure lists
modes.description: The word 'and' ending a list of signs to watch for in infants exposed in utero.
